intro.copy: See where the city is hot today and what Heilbronn is doing about it as European Green Capital 2027.

heatmap.locationNote: DWD and Open-Meteo markers show their average from 10:29 to 13:07 local time, matching the Mobile Datalogger window on 2 Sep. DWD is about 10 km east of Heilbronn; Open-Meteo is a regional grid cell.

birdhouses.noData: Bird data is not connected yet.
birdhouses.dashSubtitle: identified by AI, checked by hand
birdhouses.corrected: {count} of these visits were relabelled: the AI suggested a lookalike species from another continent, but the videos and the perch weight showed it was this bird.
birdhouses.uncertainSub: AI identifications we could not trust
birdhouses.uncertainText: The AI suggested pelicans, Canada geese, wild turkeys and hummingbirds – birds that weigh up to several kilograms or live on other continents. The perch scale never measured more than about 30 g, so these were really small songbirds.
birdhouses.uncertainNote: Checking the videos showed most of them were great tits or blue tits. Because we can't tell which ones exactly, they are kept separate instead of guessed.
birdhouses.footer: The feeder's AI often confuses European birds with similar-looking species from other continents. Visits were checked against the videos and the perch weight; implausible identifications are grouped as “Uncertain”.
